set.description: 把一个方程变形用一个未知数表示另一个，代入另一个方程消元，转化为一元一次方程。
set.name: Elimination by Substitution

criteria: 能判断各象限点的符号特征
能处理坐标轴上的点
set.description: 会判断点所在象限，坐标轴上点的特征：x 轴上点纵坐标为 0，y 轴上点横坐标为 0。
set.name: Coordinate Characteristics of Points in Quadrants and on the Coordinate Axes
set.nameZh: 象限与坐标轴上点的坐标特征

criteria: 能指出底和对应的高
能用底×高求面积
set.description: 会用底乘高计算平行四边形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Parallelogram

criteria: 能按角给三角形分类
能说出等边三角形三条边都相等
set.description: 会按角把三角形分成锐角、直角、钝角三角形，按边认出等腰三角形和等边三角形。
set.name: Classifying triangles

criteria: 能把点斜式化成一般式
能从一般式求斜率
set.description: 平面内的直线都可以写成 Ax+By+C=0，其中 A、B 不全为 0。B≠0 时斜率为 −A/B。
set.name: General equation of a line

criteria: 能说出数轴的三要素
能判断一条直线是否是数轴
set.description: 规定了原点、正方向和单位长度的直线叫数轴，数轴把数与直线上的点联系起来。
set.name: The Number Line

criteria: 能在数轴上标出整数、小数、分数
能读出数轴上点对应的数
set.description: 会在数轴上画出表示给定有理数的点，并读出数轴上点所表示的数。
set.name: Representing Rational Numbers on a Number Line

criteria: 能用有序数对表示位置
能说明为什么要有顺序
set.description: 用有顺序的两个数表示位置，如（列，行），顺序不同表示的位置不同。
set.name: Ordered Pairs

set.reason: Each coordinate axis is a number line with an origin, a direction and a unit. Plotting and reading coordinates is impossible without understanding those three elements of a number line.
set.scope: coordinate axes as two perpendicular number lines

set.reason: Each axis is a signed number line, so plotting signed coordinates uses number-to-position interpretation on it.
set.scope: axes as number lines with negatives

set.reason: A point's two coordinates form an ordered pair; swapping the entries generally changes the point.
set.scope: writing and reading point coordinates

set.reason: Gemini uses quadrant/axis features to assign coordinates in one diagram method. Coordinate differences and area can instead be computed from already supplied points without quadrant classification, so these features prepare rather than universally precede the task.
set.scope: segment lengths and areas from coordinates

set.reason: General form makes a linear system convenient. Intersections can be solved directly from point-slope or slope-intercept equations without first converting both lines to Ax+By+C=0.
set.scope: Putting two line equations into a uniform coefficient form

set.reason: Triangle classification helps recognize where an altitude may lie. The area relation and a supplied base/height can be used across all triangle types without first sorting them as acute, right or obtuse.
set.scope: locating heights in right and obtuse triangles

set.reason: The target explicitly states that the triangle has half the area of an equal-base equal-height parallelogram. Parallelogram-area meaning is needed for that specified comparison.
set.scope: triangle as half a parallelogram

criteria: 能求平行于坐标轴的线段长
能用坐标求简单图形面积
set.description: 建立坐标系，用坐标表示点、线段和多边形，并求线段长及图形面积。
set.name: Describing Simple Geometric Figures Using Coordinates
set.nameZh: 用坐标描述简单几何图形

criteria: 能说出三角形面积是等底等高平行四边形的一半
能用底×高÷2 求面积
set.description: 会用底乘高除以 2 计算三角形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Triangle

criteria: 能联立两个一次方程求交点
知道斜率相等时没有唯一交点
set.description: 两条直线的交点坐标是它们的方程联立后的公共解。
set.name: Intersection of two lines

criteria: 能画出坐标系并描点
能写出点的坐标
set.description: 两条互相垂直、原点重合的数轴构成平面直角坐标系，会根据坐标描点并读出点的坐标。
set.name: The Cartesian Coordinate System and Point Coordinates
